changelog:
Simpler layout: Home, Tournaments, Players and Club
Your matches and form are now on your profile
Back works the same everywhere, including the Android back key
Shared links open straight in the app
Organisers choose who sees contact numbers; finished events hide them
Head-to-head pairs: pick a pair and the event follows
Umpires can reschedule matches
Followers get every court or time change
Faster start-up
